meaning_en: help or support
example_en: The country sent aid to disaster victims.
examples_extra: The charity sent aid to the flood victims.
Several countries offered aid after the earthquake.

meaning_en: To suddenly remove or stop something.
example_en: The company decided to axe 50 jobs.
examples_extra: The large company axed 200 jobs last year.
The TV show was axed after one season.
note_fa: در خبرها یعنی «حذف یا لغو ناگهانی».

meaning_en: To give support to a plan or person.
example_en: The government will back the new environmental project.
examples_extra: Most members backed the new plan at yesterday's long meeting.
The bank refused to back his business idea with a loan.
note_fa: مثل back up ولی رسمی‌تر و کوتاه‌تر.

meaning_en: To prevent someone from entering a place.
example_en: Police bar protesters from entering the building.
examples_extra: The club barred him from entering after the fight.
Reporters were barred from the secret meeting room.
note_fa: منع ورود کردن — bar someone from a place.

meaning_en: An offer to pay a price.
example_en: He made a high bid for the painting.
examples_extra: The company made a bid for the smaller rival firm.
Her bid of two million won the auction at last.
note_fa: در تیتر روزنامه‌ها یعنی «تلاش»: a takeover bid.

meaning_en: A sudden, strong explosion or loud noise.
example_en: Police heard a loud blast from the building.
examples_extra: The blast broke windows in houses nearby.
We heard a loud blast from the building site.

meaning_en: A very large and dangerous fire.
example_en: Firefighters fought a huge blaze for hours.
examples_extra: The blaze destroyed three houses in the old town.
Firefighters fought the blaze for more than five hours.
note_fa: در تیتر روزنامه‌ها یعنی fire (آتش بزرگ).

meaning_en: Help something to increase or improve.
example_en: Exercise can boost your energy levels.
examples_extra: The big win really boosted the team's confidence.
A good night's sleep can really boost your memory.

meaning_en: The person in charge of workers in a company.
example_en: My boss asked me to finish the report by Friday.
examples_extra: My boss asked me to finish the report today.
She complained to her boss about the long hours.

meaning_en: To fight or disagree strongly.
example_en: Protesters clashed with police in the city.
examples_extra: The two rival teams clashed in the final.
Their strong opinions clashed during the long meeting.
note_fa: درگیری و تصادم؛ در روزنامه‌ها به‌معنای dispute.

meaning_en: To divide something into pieces with a sharp tool.
example_en: Please cut the cake into slices.
examples_extra: She cut the paper into small pieces.
He cut his finger on the broken glass.
note_fa: گذشته و اسم مفعول آن هم cut است.

meaning_en: A play or film with serious events.
example_en: We watched a historical drama on TV.
examples_extra: We watched a historical drama on television.
She loves drama more than comedy films.
note_fa: یعنی نمایش جدی؛ با comedy متضاد است.

meaning_en: To control a car or other vehicle.
example_en: I drive to work every day.
examples_extra: He drives to work every day.
Learning to drive takes a lot of practice.

meaning_en: valuable stones, or excellent things.
example_en: The article offered some real gems of advice.
examples_extra: The museum has a collection of rare gems.
This book is full of little gems of advice.
note_fa: کتاب: gems = jewels؛ معنای مجازی: نکته‌های ناب و ارزشمند.

meaning_en: Permission to start or continue with something.
example_en: The project got the go-ahead from the board.
examples_extra: The project got the go-ahead yesterday.
We are waiting for the go-ahead.

meaning_en: The top part of your body.
example_en: My head hurts a little.
examples_extra: He slowly nodded his head in silent agreement.
She gently shook her head and smiled warmly.

meaning_en: (n) A very popular song or film; (v) to reach a target.
example_en: The new app was a big hit with users.
examples_extra: The song was a big hit last summer.
The film was a hit with audiences.
note_fa: a hit یعنی یک موفقیت بزرگ.

meaning_en: A metal object used to open locks.
example_en: I can't find my house key.
examples_extra: I cannot find my house keys.
He turned the key in the lock.
note_fa: کلید؛ key هم اسم است هم صفت (key point).

meaning_en: To connect two or more things.
example_en: The new road will link the two towns.
examples_extra: The new bridge links the two small islands.
Scientists have firmly linked smoking to lung cancer.

meaning_en: A very difficult or unpleasant experience.
example_en: The long journey was a terrible ordeal.
examples_extra: The exam was a real ordeal.
They survived the terrible ordeal.

meaning_en: To force someone out of a position.
example_en: The president was ousted from power.
examples_extra: The rebels ousted the president.
They voted to oust the chairman.
note_fa: یعنی با زور برکنار کردن؛ رسمی است.

meaning_en: an urgent request for something.
example_en: The charity made a plea for donations.
examples_extra: They made a plea for help.
His desperate plea was ignored.
note_fa: درخواست فوری/جدی؛ plea for mercy یعنی درخواست بخشش.

meaning_en: a serious promise or agreement.
example_en: The government made a pledge to reduce taxes.
examples_extra: The company made a pledge to reduce waste.
He signed the pledge yesterday.

meaning_en: a clever plan to trick someone.
example_en: It was a clever ploy to get attention.
examples_extra: It was just a ploy to get money.
The discount was a marketing ploy.

meaning_en: A survey of public opinion.
example_en: The latest poll shows public support.
examples_extra: The poll shows a close race.
She won the poll easily.

meaning_en: An official investigation into a crime or problem.
example_en: Police launched a probe into the incident.
examples_extra: Police launched a probe into the scandal.
The probe revealed serious errors.

meaning_en: to leave a job or school
example_en: He decided to quit his job.
examples_extra: He quit his job last month.
She decided to quit smoking.
note_fa: یعنی ترک کردن/استعفا دادن؛ quit smoking هم رایج است.

meaning_en: A puzzling question or statement.
example_en: Can you solve this riddle? What has an eye but cannot see?
examples_extra: Can you solve this simple riddle?
The children enjoyed the riddles in the book.
note_fa: معما؛ solve a riddle: حل معما.

meaning_en: Angry disagreement or conflict between people.
example_en: The country was torn by political strife.
examples_extra: The country suffered years of civil strife.
The ongoing family strife upset the children.

meaning_en: Formal discussions between groups or countries.
example_en: Peace talks will begin next week.
examples_extra: The peace talks continue today.
They held talks in Paris.

meaning_en: a statement of intent to cause harm.
example_en: The storm poses a threat to coastal areas.
examples_extra: The threat of rain kept everyone indoors.
He received an anonymous threat by email.

meaning_en: To make a serious promise to do something.
example_en: The leader vowed to improve the country's economy.
examples_extra: They solemnly vowed to help each other always.
She firmly vowed never to return there again.
note_fa: سوگند خوردن؛ کتاب: vow یعنی promise.

meaning_en: To marry someone (often used in news headlines).
example_en: The prince will wed his fiancée next month.
examples_extra: The prince wedded the princess in June.
They were wed in a small chapel.

meaning_en: To express opinions publicly.
example_en: Politicians air views on current affairs.
examples_extra: She aired her views on TV.
They air their views openly.

meaning_en: The amount of time a person or topic is broadcast.
example_en: The debate received significant airtime.
examples_extra: The show got prime airtime.
Candidates compete for airtime daily.

meaning_en: A collection of historical documents or records.
example_en: The library holds a vast archive of historical newspapers.
examples_extra: The letters are kept in the national archive.
You can search the online archive.

meaning_en: An earlier issue of a newspaper or magazine.
example_en: I need a back copy of last month's science journal.
examples_extra: You can read back copies online.
The library keeps back copies.

meaning_en: Reporting news for radio or television.
example_en: She pursued a career in broadcast journalism.
examples_extra: She studied broadcast journalism at university.
He works in broadcast journalism for the BBC.

meaning_en: News reported by ordinary people, not professional journalists.
example_en: Citizen journalism played a key role in documenting the protest.
examples_extra: Citizen journalism played a key role during the protests.
Smartphones have made citizen journalism possible everywhere.

meaning_en: The amount of space a newspaper gives to a story.
example_en: The scandal received many column inches in the tabloids.
examples_extra: The political scandal earned him many column inches.
The newspapers gave the story few column inches.

meaning_en: Acting wildly or irrationally, often due to anger or excitement.
example_en: A crazed gunman opened fire in the crowded market.
examples_extra: The crazed gunman was arrested.
Tabloids use words like crazed for drama.

meaning_en: The possibility of suffering harm or injury.
example_en: Experts warn of danger from rising sea levels.
examples_extra: The climbers were in grave danger yesterday.
Smoking poses a serious danger to public health.

meaning_en: Making false statements that harm someone's reputation.
example_en: She sued the newspaper for defamation of character.
examples_extra: He sued the paper for defamation of character.
Proving defamation of character is very serious.

meaning_en: Be sent to be printed (for a newspaper/magazine).
example_en: The newspaper goes to press at midnight.
examples_extra: The paper goes to press at midnight.
The book goes to press next week.

meaning_en: A man armed with a gun.
example_en: Police are searching for the suspected gunman.
examples_extra: A gunman attacked the building.
Police quickly arrested the armed gunman.

meaning_en: Sensational newspapers focusing on scandal and gossip.
example_en: The gutter press often invades celebrities' privacy for sales.
examples_extra: The gutter press loves scandals.
She hates the gutter press.

meaning_en: Showing great bravery; very courageous.
example_en: The firefighters made a heroic effort to save lives.
examples_extra: His heroic act saved lives.
She made a heroic effort.

meaning_en: Become very famous and widely reported in the news.
example_en: The scandal quickly hit the headlines across the nation.
examples_extra: The scandal hit the headlines.
She hit the headlines around the world.

meaning_en: To search for something or someone diligently.
example_en: Police are hunting for the escaped suspect.
examples_extra: Police are hunting the suspect.
She's hunting for a new job.

meaning_en: To officially make a public statement to the media.
example_en: The company will issue a press release about the merger.
examples_extra: The company issued a press release.
They will issue a press release tomorrow.
note_fa: issue a press release یعنی بیانیه‌ی مطبوعاتی دادن.

meaning_en: To officially make a public announcement to the media.
example_en: The minister issued a press statement regarding the new policy.
examples_extra: The minister issued a press statement.
She issued a press statement yesterday.

meaning_en: A published false statement damaging a person's reputation.
example_en: The newspaper faced a lawsuit for libel.
examples_extra: The actor sued the paper for libel.
The article was a clear libel.

meaning_en: An uncouth, aggressive, or ill-mannered man.
example_en: The lout was shouting obscenities in the street.
examples_extra: A drunken lout shouted at the bus driver.
The quiet bar refused to serve the louts.

meaning_en: Public interest shown by newspapers, television, or radio.
example_en: The scandal attracted widespread media attention.
examples_extra: The sensational court case attracted huge media attention.
The shy young actress always avoids media attention.

meaning_en: The reporting of a particular event or topic.
example_en: The election received extensive media coverage.
examples_extra: The royal wedding received very wide media coverage.
The international media coverage focused on the victims.

meaning_en: Exaggerated publicity or advertising.
example_en: The new movie got a lot of media hype.
examples_extra: You should not believe all the media hype.
The expensive film failed despite the media hype.

meaning_en: The level of attention given by news organizations.
example_en: The celebrity's wedding generated huge media interest.
examples_extra: There has been little media interest so far.
The sensational murder trial sparked great media interest.

meaning_en: News stories or accounts published by media outlets.
example_en: Media reports confirmed the incident.
examples_extra: Several recent media reports suggest he will resign.
According to several media reports, the talks collapsed.

meaning_en: Searching for and exposing scandalous information.
example_en: The newspaper was known for its aggressive muck-raking journalism.
examples_extra: The tabloid press loves cheap muck-raking stories.
Sensational muck-raking always sells more newspapers.

meaning_en: An incident or event.
example_en: Police reported a rare occurrence of vandalism overnight.
examples_extra: It was a rare occurrence.
Strikes are a common occurrence.

meaning_en: Journalism published on the internet.
example_en: Online journalism has transformed how we consume news.
examples_extra: She works in online journalism.
Online journalism is growing fast.

meaning_en: Photographers who follow famous people to take pictures.
example_en: The paparazzi chased the celebrity down the street.
examples_extra: Paparazzi followed the star everywhere.
The paparazzi took photos outside the hotel.
note_fa: جمع است ولی مفرد هم به کار می‌رود.

meaning_en: An interview given to journalists by a public figure.
example_en: The minister held a press conference to announce his resignation.
examples_extra: The minister held a press conference.
She answered questions at the press conference.

meaning_en: An organization that tries to influence public policy.
example_en: Environmental pressure groups advocate for stricter regulations.
examples_extra: A pressure group campaigned against the law.
The pressure group lobbies parliament regularly.
note_fa: گروه فشار؛ سازمان تأثیرگذار بر سیاست عمومی.

meaning_en: Journalism delivered through newspapers and magazines.
example_en: Print journalism faces challenges from digital media.
examples_extra: She has a career in print journalism.
Print journalism faces tough competition online.

meaning_en: Interpret or explain something in your own way.
example_en: The politician put his own gloss on the economic data.
examples_extra: He put his own gloss on the events.
Each paper puts its own gloss on the story.

meaning_en: Present information in a way that favors your viewpoint.
example_en: The PR team tried to put their own spin on the negative news.
examples_extra: They put their own spin on the news.
She puts her own spin on every story.
note_fa: جهت‌دهی به اطلاعات به نفع دیدگاه خود.

meaning_en: A newspaper or magazine considered to be of poor quality.
example_en: Don't believe everything you read in that sensationalist rag.
examples_extra: She refuses to read that rag.
The story appeared in a cheap local rag.
note_fa: کتاب: rag = low-quality newspaper؛ روزنامه بی‌ارزش.

meaning_en: A period of extreme violence and oppression.
example_en: The dictator's reign of terror lasted for decades.
examples_extra: The reign of terror ended.
People feared his reign of terror.

meaning_en: to publish or broadcast a news report
example_en: The newspaper decided to run a story on the scandal.
examples_extra: The paper refused to run the story without proof.
They plan to run a story on the scandal.

meaning_en: An exclusive news story published before rivals.
example_en: The newspaper claimed a major scoop on the scandal.
examples_extra: The reporter got a scoop on the minister's resignation.
Every paper wanted the scoop before its rivals.

meaning_en: To try to attract public attention.
example_en: The celebrity often seeks publicity for her new ventures.
examples_extra: He constantly seeks cheap publicity.
They really don't seek publicity.

meaning_en: To kick or hit a ball into the net.
example_en: The striker managed to shoot a goal in the final minute.
examples_extra: He shoots a goal every match.
Strikers shoot a goal under pressure.

meaning_en: A small, bright meteor burning up in Earth's atmosphere.
example_en: We saw a shooting star streak across the night sky.
examples_extra: We saw a shooting star.
Make a wish on a shooting star.

meaning_en: Websites and applications enabling users to create and share content.
example_en: Social media has transformed how we communicate daily.
examples_extra: She spends hours on social media.
Social media shapes public opinion.

meaning_en: A short, memorable phrase or sentence from a speech.
example_en: Politicians often use catchy soundbites in their campaigns.
examples_extra: The speech was full of soundbites.
Reporters love a good soundbite.

meaning_en: To feature a famous person as the main performer.
meaning_fa: ستاره بودن، نقش اصلی را بازی کردن
example_en: Brad Pitt to star in new action movie.
examples_extra: The film stars a famous actor.
She starred in three comedies.
note_fa: اینجا فعل است: نقش اصلی داشتن.

meaning_en: An article or report in a newspaper or magazine.
example_en: The front-page story detailed the latest scandal.
examples_extra: She told us a funny story.
The story has a surprise ending.

meaning_en: A newspaper with small pages, often focusing on sensational stories.
example_en: The tabloid ran a scandalous celebrity story.
examples_extra: The story appeared in a tabloid.
Tabloids love celebrity scandals and gossip.

meaning_en: Access and use valuable information or resources.
example_en: Researchers need to tap useful sources for their project.
examples_extra: Good writers tap useful sources.
She tapped useful sources for data.

meaning_en: Extreme fear.
example_en: The news of the attack spread terror.
examples_extra: She screamed in absolute terror.
The sudden attack spread terror everywhere.

meaning_en: A violent person, often a criminal.
example_en: Police arrested the thug responsible for the street attack.
examples_extra: Thugs attacked him at night.
The violent thug was finally arrested.

meaning_en: A great victory or success.
example_en: Winning the championship was a huge triumph for the team.
examples_extra: The team celebrated their triumph.
It was a triumph for democracy.

meaning_en: in an incorrect or unjust manner.
example_en: Man wrongly accused of theft released.
examples_extra: She was wrongly accused yesterday.
He spelled my name wrongly again.

meaning_en: a rude, aggressive, or badly behaved young man.
example_en: Police arrested a yob for vandalism last night.
examples_extra: Drunk yobs smashed the windows.
A gang of yobs gathered outside.
note_fa: غیررسمی بریتانیایی: جوان شرور و بی‌تربیت.
